children: Southern Company completed an offering of 40 million equity units, each with a $50 stated amount and an 8.625% annual distribution rate.
The offering included 35 million units plus 5 million units from the underwriters’ fully exercised over-allotment option.
Annual distributions consist of 3.125% contract adjustment payments and 5.50% interest on the remarketable senior notes.
Each unit includes a purchase contract requiring the holder to buy a specified number of common shares for $50 by December 15, 2029.
Each unit also includes beneficial interests in senior notes due 2031 and 2034, pledged as collateral for the stock purchase obligation.
